assetCoverage.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, our asset coverage ratio stood at 339.4% based on the outstanding principal amount of our senior securities representing indebtedness of $1.9 billion and our asset coverage ratio on our senior securities that are stock was 177.6%.

floatingShare.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, 75.96% of the interest earning investments in our portfolio, at fair value, bore interest at floating rates.

portfolioCompanies.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, we had investments in 91 portfolio companies and other portfolio investments, which had an amortized cost of $6,315,369 and a fair value of $6,342,558.
